Definition: from G2411 and G4813; a temple-despoiler:--robber of churches.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hierósylos means a temple-robber. It occurs just once, in Acts.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hierósylos as it stands — a temple-robber — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
